approval_ref: The active user goal requires continued efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements for RFI, Submittal and Email content.
notes: A nested message/rfc822 part without filename or Content-Disposition currently enters the parent body and is absent from attachment inventory.
The leaked forwarded question changes a current RFI response to MIXED and can reach evidence extraction.
Use the standard-library MIME maintype as an attachment boundary in both parsing and reviewer-selected import paths.
No automatic attachment analysis, recursion, mailbox access or model call is permitted.
635 Python, 24 UI and 11 deployment-boundary tests passed offline; unmarked forwarded messages stay outside parent evidence and remain available for explicit selected import.
title: Stop unmarked forwarded-message leakage
objective: Treat nested message MIME parts as inert, reviewable attachments even when filename and Content-Disposition are absent, preventing forwarded content from changing the parent Email/RFI/Submittal result.
